text: According to Albert's disclosures and Terms of Use, there are no late fees or interest on an Instant Advance. Repaying late can still affect your access: if you repay within 15 days after the due date, any suspension may lift once your covering deposits complete. If you repay more than 15 days late, you may be suspended from new advances for 30 days or more. One repayment help article says "late fees may apply," which conflicts with the disclosures, so check the Instant section of the app or contact Albert support to confirm for your account.
